data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2022 with gross claims outstanding of 1,806.7 (USD millions). A net release on prior years of 57.8 (USD millions) was recorded in 2022, primarily driven by favourable claims development across several classes (notably Marine and Property) and reduced COVID-19 reserving uncertainty, partly offset by some adverse movements in Specialty. The movement is presented in the report as a net release; no gross prior-year aggregate movement was separately quantified in the notes, so the reported net figure has been used.

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts are taken from the syndicate financial statements which are presented in US dollars (USD). Field names contain 'gbp' per the template but amounts are in the report's native currency (USD). The 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note in the report explicitly states a net release of $57.8m; a gross prior-year movement (gross of reinsurers' share) was not provided in that movement note. A gross claims development triangle is present in the notes (page 40) but was not unambiguously extractable for a full gross prior-year movement calculation within this routine; therefore the explicit net prior-year release ($57.8m) from the movement note was used (NET of reinsurance). Mapping of internal class names to the limited standard Lloyd's LOB list required judgement (e.g. 'Political Risk' and 'Political Violence and War' were mapped to 'Reinsurance - Specialty' for the lob_movements entries).
